## Checks

- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`).
- [ ] I say below which checks I ran and which I could not run.
- [ ] I say below how I relate to the system or files this changes.

For a crosswalk:

- [ ] A first crosswalk touches only `crosswalk/<system>.yaml`, with no vocabulary or descriptor edits in the same pull request.
- [ ] Every mapped field states its evidence basis, either a pinned public source or the principal-attestation fields that CONTRIBUTING.md requires. Each `partial` mapping says what does not carry over.
- [ ] The file names a maintainer for the system.

A change to `PRINCIPLES.md`, `SHARED-DECISIONS.md` or `docs/boundary-map.md` follows the review windows and approvals in [SHARED-DECISIONS.md](https://github.com/NOSAI-Federation/agent-governance-vocabulary/blob/main/SHARED-DECISIONS.md).
